_about: Verified official Pakistani bank/telco/authority helplines. Ye 'legitimate whitelist' hai — security-critical: galat number 'verified official' label dekar victim ko scammer par bharosa karwa dega, aur asli bank ka number 'suspicious' kehla kar uski helpline block kar dega.
_provenance: Har number entity ki APNI official website se liya gaya hai (source_url). Entries sirf tab add karein jab aap khud us page par number dekh chuke hon. Automated scraper (_verify_numbers.py) bohat se sites par 403/DNS fail hota hai — is liye har number manually verify karna zaroori hai.
_how_to_add: Naya number: (1) entity ki official site ka contact page kholein, (2) number + surrounding context dekh kar confirm karein, (3) source_url wo exact page likhein, (4) entity ki list me number add karein. Short codes (111/777/310 jaise 3-4 digit) is list me JAAN BOOJH kar nahi daale — wo VoIP se asani se spoof ho jate hain.

HBL.note: General 111-111-425. Baqi product-specific helplines bhi official hain.

Bank Alfalah.note: Bank Alfalah 021/042 111 225 111. Baqi product lines (Premier/Alfa/Authorization) bhi usi page par hain.

Soneri Bank.note: 021 111-766-374 (111-SONERI). 111-567-890 company secretariat UAN hai, customer helpline nahi.

Jazz.note: 021-111 300 300. Jazz ka '111' (prepaid) aur '777' (postpaid) 3-digit short codes hain — jaan boojh kar nahi daale, VoIP se spoof ho sakte hain.

NADRA.note: 1700 (short code), 111-786-100 helpline. NOTE: nadra.gov.pk scraper/webfetch ko 403 deta hai — ye manually verify kiye gaye hain, dobara check kar lein.

Banking Mohtasib (BMP).note: Bank ka faisla pasand na aaye to yahan shikayat hoti hai. SBP ka apna Sunwai portal bhi hai: https://sunwai.sbp.org.pk/ aur complaint.sbp.org.pk.

Zong.note: Purane code se 111-222-111. Aaj official site se verify nahi ho paya (DNS fail).

MCB.note: Purane code se 111-000-622. Aaj official site se verify nahi ho paya.

Allied Bank.note: Purane code se 111-225-225 (allied contact centre). Aaj verify nahi ho paya.

Bank of the Punjab.note: Purane code se 111-200-100. bop.com.pk pe scraper block tha, manual verify bhi pending tha.

_still_to_verify._comment: In entities ke koi verified number abhi nahi hai — purane code me bhi nahi the, sirf scraper targets the. Inhe add karne se pehle official site se number verify karein.
